name: PreviewMessage
description: Lets you preview your message before sending it.
summary: An eye button by the message box that shows your message, as only you can see it, before you send it
notes: While the message box holds text (or files), an eye button, "Preview Message", appears beside it. Clicking it adds your message to the chat as Discord's "Only you can see this" messages look: from you, with your formatting, mentions and emojis rendered and the files you attached (images shown, other files by name and size), and a "Dismiss message" link that removes it. Nothing is sent to Discord; the preview disappears when you switch channels or restart, as upstream's does.
